_comments: Issue #159. Contract.NonRenewalOutcome is stored. A save records it through a trigger; an expiry
has no save behind it, so this action applies the same rule to every contract whose stored value
differs from it today. The rule lives in fnContractNonRenewalOutcome; the action only calls it.

fields.Name: Record Contract Renewal Outcomes
fields.Description: Record the renewal-risk label (NonRenewalOutcome) on every contract whose stored value no longer matches its dates, such as a contract whose end date has passed. Contracts already labelled correctly are left alone.
fields.UserPrompt: Record the renewal outcome on contracts that have concluded.
